title: Herbal Silky Malaysian Flour Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Malaysian dish featuring herbal notes and silky texture, cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot. This recipe is FODMAP friendly and uses mushimono steam cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot by filling the bottom with water and bringing to a boil over high heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine basmati flour, water, coconut oil, ginger, lemongrass, pandan leaves, salt, and black pepper, and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes silky and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Place the dough balls into the preheated tandoor clay pot, leaving some space between each ball.
Cover the pot with a lid and steam cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and check if the biryani is cooked through and fluffy.
Serve the Herbal Silky Malaysian Flour Biryani hot, garnished with additional pandan leaves if desired.
